fields.Name: T212 - Developer Tools Class Registry Search Filter
fields.Description: Exercises the OnSearchChange/FilteredGroups filtering logic, not the mere-render check T194 performs.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and choose the Admin app. Open the 'Developer Tools' section, then in its left sub-navigation click 'Class Registry'. Note the initial 'Total registrations' stat and the list of base-class groups. Type a term into the 'Search base class, subclass, or key...' box - first something broad like 'Entity' and observe the group list narrow, then something that will not match like 'zzzznotaclass'. Success is the search FEATURE responding: the grouped list narrows to matching base classes for a real term, and shows a clear 'No registrations match' empty state for the nonsense term. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Typing a real search term visibly narrows the class-registry group list to matching entries
Typing a nonsense term shows a no-results empty state (rather than the full list or a crash), confirming the filter is live
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
